ic_definition.type: Spearman rank IC + partial Spearman controlling DIST_INV
ic_definition.formula_raw: IC_day = corr(rank(signal), rank(target)) across ±3% moneyness strikes
ic_definition.formula_primary: partial Spearman: rank(signal,target,DIST_INV); residualize ranks on DIST_INV; Pearson of residuals
ic_definition.aggregate: mean IC, IC IR = mean/stdev, hit rate P(IC>0), bootstrap 95% CI
ic_definition.placebo: shuffle signal values within day, recompute Spearman / partial Spearman
ic_definition.causal: signals from morning_full / ~10:00 snapshot; targets from RTH ≥10:15 ET
